summary: Irish-born Philadelphian recorded as the father of Honora Dwyer, though the link is unproven; John's 5th-great-grandfather.
bio: Dennis Dwyer was born about 1807 in Ireland and died in Philadelphia on 25 March 1875. Family records make him the father of Honora Dwyer, John's 4th-great-grandmother, but the relationship is unproven; he may instead have been her brother.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
openQuestions: Find a Dennis Dwyer (1807-1875) burial/obituary in Plymouth or Elmira.
